As Wells Fargo Co New (WFC) Shares Declined, Palisade Capital Management Has Decreased by $765,000 Its Holding; As Apple (AAPL) Stock Price Declined, Holder Daiwa Sb Investments LTD Decreased Its Stake by $6.21 Million
May 12, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Palisade Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Wells Fargo Co New (WFC) by 67.64% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Palisade Capital Management Llc sold 12,750 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.98% with the market. The hedge fund held 6,100 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $370,000, down from 18,850 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Palisade Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Wells Fargo Co New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $265.33 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.37% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $54.45. About 14.42M shares traded. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has declined 7.75% since May 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.30% the S&P500.
Daiwa Sb Investments Ltd decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 53.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Daiwa Sb Investments Ltd sold 36,740 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 32,260 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.46M, down from 69,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Daiwa Sb Investments Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.95 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $188.59. About 25.70 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
